args.sql:
SELECT 
  em.reckeylink,
  em.env_metrics->'temperature'->>'excursion_count' as exc_count,
  em.env_metrics->'temperature'->>'avg_c' as avg_c,
  em.env_metrics->'temperature'->>'max_c' as max_c,
  em.env_metrics->'temperature'->>'min_c' as min_c,
  em.env_metrics->'temperature'->>'alarm_count' as alarm_count,
  em.env_metrics->'temperature'->>'excursion_duration_min' as exc_dur
FROM environmentalmonitoring em
WHERE (em.env_metrics->'temperature'->>'excursion_count')::int > 0
LIMIT 5;

-- Test: Calculate MKT approximation using available temp data
-- Using avg_c as the primary temperature indicator
-- MKT = (-83144/8.3144) / ln(exp(-83144/(8.3144 * (avg_c + 273.15))))
-- This simplifies to approximately avg_c + 273.15 - some adjustment

SELECT 
  em.reckeylink,
  (em.env_metrics->'temperature'->>'avg_c')::float as avg_c,
  (em.env_metrics->'temperature'->>'max_c')::float as max_c,
  (em.env_metrics->'temperature'->>'min_c')::float as min_c,
  -- MKT approximation using the formula
  -- ΔH = 83144 J/mol, R = 8.3144 J/mol/K
  -- For multiple readings approximated by avg:
  ROUND(CAST(
    (-83144.0/8.3144) / LN(
      EXP(-83144.0/(8.3144 * ((em.env_metrics->'temperature'->>'avg_c')::float + 273.15)))
    ) - 273.15
  AS numeric), 2) as mkt_approx
FROM environmentalmonitoring em
WHERE (em.env_metrics->'temperature'->>'excursion_count')::int > 0
LIMIT 5;

-- Calculate MKT using avg, max, min as representative temperature points
-- ΔH = 83144 J/mol, R = 8.3144 J/mol/K
-- Convert Celsius to Kelvin first
SELECT 
  ROUND(CAST(
    AVG(
      (-83144.0/8.3144) / LN(
        (EXP(-83144.0/(8.3144 * ((em.env_metrics->'temperature'->>'max_c')::float + 273.15)) + 
           EXP(-83144.0/(8.3144 * ((em.env_metrics->'temperature'->>'avg_c')::float + 273.15)) + 
           EXP(-83144.0/(8.3144 * ((em.env_metrics->'temperature'->>'min_c')::float + 273.15)))
        ) / 3.0
      )
    ) - 273.15
  AS numeric), 2) as avg_mkt
FROM environmentalmonitoring em
WHERE (em.env_metrics->'temperature'->>'excursion_count')::int > 0;
